_comment: Every number here is a configurable, documented assumption or a published fare table. Change it here; the advisor reports the value it used.

service_area.name: Delhi service area
service_area.note: Bounding box used to filter transit data; start/end points must lie inside the NCT of Delhi boundary (with a small tolerance).

walking.note: Straight-line distance x detour factor at walking speed (rule-based).

transfer_buffers_min._note: Minimum time between arriving at a stop and the departure you can catch (rule-based).

metro.source: DMRC fare revision effective 25 Aug 2025 (distance slabs). Interchanges inside the paid area are one journey.
metro.airport_line_note: Airport Express (Orange) legs are priced with the standard slabs; DMRC charges up to Rs 75 there, so treat those as a lower bound.

bus.source: OTD bus GTFS fare_rules/fare_attributes (stage fares per route and stop pair).
bus.fallback_source: DTC non-AC distance slabs used only when the feed has no fare for a stop pair.
bus.women_free_note: Women travel free on DTC and cluster buses with the pink ticket/Saheli card.

rail.source: Indian Railways unreserved second-class ordinary fare (assumption: minimum fare covers trips inside Delhi).

emissions_kg_per_pkm._note: Assumed per-passenger-km factors for Delhi (configurable). Used for comparison, not certification.

bus_model.note: Only the Outer Ring Road eastbound segment (Chirag Delhi -> Nehru Place) is in the model's approved scope. The model is taken from the first source that passes its checks: the Phase 3 registry champion (audit chain valid, gate passed, artifact hash matches), the deployed Docker API, or the Phase 2 approved bundle.

geocoder.note: OpenStreetMap data via Photon (search-as-you-type) and Nominatim (reverse fallback, max 1 request/s). Results are cached and limited to Delhi. Offline, place search falls back to ward localities and transit stops.

cab._note: Cab legs: road routing (OSRM on OpenStreetMap) or a straight-line rule, times a Delhi traffic factor, plus a pickup wait. Fares are the Delhi Transport Department's notified meter fares, shown as indicative. Every value here is a configurable assumption.

routing.note: The public OSRM server is a best-effort demo for light use; for heavier use run your own OSRM (Docker) and change the url.

fallback.note: Used when road routing is unavailable: straight-line distance x detour factor at a free-flow city speed, then the traffic factor.

cab.traffic_note: OSRM durations assume free-flowing roads. The factor stretches them for Delhi traffic by time of day (assumption; no live traffic data is used).
cab.fare_source: Delhi Transport Department fare notification of 9 Jan 2023 for black-and-yellow taxis and auto-rickshaws (meter fares). App cabs (Uber, Ola) set their own dynamic prices, so cab fares are indicative.
cab.co2_note: kg CO2 per vehicle-km for CNG vehicles (assumption) divided by occupancy gives kg per passenger-km.
